Worth Knowing

Plan the water around conditions, not a fixed clock.

Sharm’s best days are built around the Red Sea. Book park and boat outings with licensed operators, follow the briefing on wind and current, and leave room to swap a northern reef day with a sheltered shore day when conditions change.

Outside resort districts, dress respectfully and agree taxi prices or an in-app fare before leaving. Carry small Egyptian-pound notes for tips and keep drinking water with you on desert-facing excursions.
